_meta.description: Upgrade card library for the Legion app, organized by upgrade slot category (the icon shown in a unit's upgrade bar).
_meta.verification_status: PARTIAL SEED. Only the 29 generic (non-faction, non-unit-specific) cards from the original 'Upgrade Card Pack' are populated. Name+category confirmed directly (roster_verified:true). COVERAGE GAP UNCHANGED: this file still has ZERO entries for faction-specific and unit-specific upgrade cards (Armament, Crew, Generator, Hardpoint, Heavy Weapon, Ordnance, Personnel, Programming, Pilot categories -- the majority of upgrade cards in the game, one set per unit expansion) and ZERO entries from the newer 191-card 'Upgrades Card Pack'. See docs/TODO.md. EFFECT-TEXT PASS on 2026-08-23: web-searched a real effect-text summary for all 29 cards (search-engine-synthesized from community sources -- Fandom wiki pages, upgrade-analysis blogs, forum threads -- not a single verbatim primary-source quote per card, since no working direct-fetch source was found; see each card's own `notes` for what was checked). Most effect descriptions are marked `effect_verified: true` on that basis. Points costs were left mostly UNVERIFIED -- multiple cards have conflicting or era-dependent figures across sources (points updates in 2019, 2022, Aug 2024, June 2025, and April 2026 all changed some of these cards), and this project's standing rule is a wrong number is worse than a blank one. Only costs with one clean, uncontested figure found were marked verified.

upgrades.name: Aggressive Tactics
upgrades.effect_description: While you are the nominated commander, after issuing orders, choose up to 4 friendly units with faceup order tokens. Each chosen unit gains 1 surge token.
upgrades.notes: Effect sourced 2026-08-23 via web search (community sources, not a single primary quote). Points cost conflicting across sources (10 vs 15) -- left unverified rather than guessing which is current.

upgrades.name: Commanding Presence
upgrades.effect_description: When issuing orders, you can issue orders at range 4.
upgrades.notes: Effect sourced 2026-08-23 via web search. No points figure found from any checked source.

upgrades.name: Esteemed Leader
upgrades.effect_description: While you are defending, each friendly Corps trooper unit at range 1 gains Guardian 1.
upgrades.notes: Effect sourced 2026-08-23 via web search. No points figure found from any checked source.

upgrades.name: Improvised Orders
upgrades.effect_description: After an order token is drawn from a friendly order pool, draw a second order token from that pool. Choose one to use and shuffle the other back into the order pool.
upgrades.notes: Effect and unique_card:true sourced 2026-08-23 via web search, describing the card as reworked in the April 2026 Development Update (a unique card, and no longer readying during the End Phase the way it previously did). `unique_card` was `false` in the original draft entry; corrected here based on that update. No points figure found.

upgrades.name: Strict Orders
upgrades.effect_description: When a friendly trooper unit with a faceup order token activates, during its Rally step, it may remove 1 suppression token instead of rolling defense dice.
upgrades.notes: Effect sourced 2026-08-23 via web search. No points figure found from any checked source.

upgrades.name: Comms Jammer
upgrades.effect_description: Enemy units at range 1 cannot be issued orders, unless they are issuing an order to themselves.
upgrades.notes: Sourced 2026-08-23 via web search. Points cost was originally 15, dropped to 5 in a points update -- 5 is the figure given as current by the source checked, but the exact update date wasn't confirmed.

upgrades.name: Comms Relay
upgrades.notes: UNSOURCED as of 2026-08-23: web search returned no usable effect text or points figure for this specific card (results were dominated by other comms cards and general product listings).

upgrades.name: HQ Uplink
upgrades.effect_description: Exhaustible card. During the Issue Orders step of the Command Phase, issue an order to yourself.
upgrades.notes: Sourced 2026-08-23 via web search (community upgrade-analysis article), one clean/uncontested points figure found.

upgrades.name: Linked Targeting Array
upgrades.effect_description: Grants Target 1 (after you are issued an order, gain 1 aim token).
upgrades.notes: Sourced 2026-08-23 via web search. The source also described this card as restricted to Emplacement Trooper or Vehicle unit types specifically -- narrower than this app's `restriction` enum currently models (generic/faction/character/affiliation/battle-force has no unit-type option), so `restriction` is left as `generic` rather than forcing an inaccurate fit; flagging this gap rather than silently mis-tagging it. No points figure found.

upgrades.name: Long-Range Comlink
upgrades.effect_description: During the Command Phase, you can be issued orders by friendly commander or operative units regardless of range.
upgrades.notes: Effect sourced 2026-08-23 via web search; source also noted an errata adjustment in a 2019 rules reference update. No points figure found.

upgrades.name: Battle Meditation
upgrades.effect_description: When you issue orders using a command card, you may issue one of those orders to any friendly unit on the battlefield, instead of a unit indicated on the command card.
upgrades.notes: Effect sourced 2026-08-23 via web search. No points figure found from any checked source.

upgrades.name: Force Guidance
upgrades.effect_description: Exhaustible card. Choose up to 2 friendly units at range 1-2; each chosen unit gains 1 surge token.
upgrades.notes: Sourced 2026-08-23 via web search, one clean/uncontested points figure found.

upgrades.name: Force Push
upgrades.effect_description: A Force-capable unit may choose an enemy unit at range 1 and perform a speed-1 move with that unit, even if it is engaged.
upgrades.notes: Effect sourced 2026-08-23 via web search. Points cost has changed repeatedly (originally 10, raised to 40 in the Aug 2024 refresh per one source) and wasn't independently reconfirmed against the more recent April 2026 update this project otherwise treats as its baseline -- left unverified rather than guessing which figure is current.

upgrades.name: Force Reflexes
upgrades.effect_description: Exhaustible card. Gain 1 dodge token as a free action.
upgrades.notes: Effect sourced 2026-08-23 via web search. Points cost appears to be CHARACTER-VARIABLE rather than flat (one source cites 15 points on Darth Vader vs 5 points on Luke Skywalker) -- this app's schema models one flat `points` value per upgrade, so left unverified/null rather than picking one character's cost as if universal. Worth a schema note for future unit-specific-pricing support.

upgrades.name: Saber Throw
upgrades.effect_description: Choose one of your melee weapons. Perform a ranged attack with that weapon against an enemy unit at range 1-2, using half of that weapon's dice (rounded up). This is treated as an attack action.
upgrades.notes: Sourced 2026-08-23 via web search, explicitly dated to the April 2026 Development Update (raised from 5 to 10 points that update) -- matches this project's stated rules baseline, higher confidence than most other entries in this pass.

upgrades.name: Electrobinoculars
upgrades.effect_description: Gain Spotter 1 (choose 1 friendly unit at range 1; that unit gains 1 aim token). B1 Battle Droids may ignore this card's Gear-slot requirement.
upgrades.notes: Effect sourced 2026-08-23 via web search. No points figure found from any checked source.

upgrades.name: Emergency Stims
upgrades.effect_description: During an attack, when you would suffer wounds, you may prevent up to 2 of them and place an equal number of wound tokens on this card instead. At the end of your next activation, discard each token on this card and suffer wounds equal to the number discarded.
upgrades.notes: Effect sourced 2026-08-23 via web search. No points figure found from any checked source.

upgrades.name: Environmental Gear
upgrades.effect_description: Gain Unhindered (ignore the effects of difficult terrain).
upgrades.notes: Sourced 2026-08-23 via web search, described as the current cost after a recent points update -- exact update date not confirmed, but only one figure was found (no conflicting values), so kept as verified.

upgrades.name: Grappling Hooks
upgrades.effect_description: Gain Expert Climber (while clambering, do not roll defense dice or suffer wounds).
upgrades.notes: Effect sourced 2026-08-23 via web search. No points figure found from any checked source.

upgrades.name: Recon Intel
upgrades.effect_description: Grants Scout 1 (after you deploy, you may perform a speed-1 move).
upgrades.notes: Effect sourced 2026-08-23 via web search. A points figure of 8 was mentioned as a recent-update cost, but the source's phrasing ('according to one source') wasn't confident enough to mark verified -- left as an unsourced lead, not a value to trust for list-building.

upgrades.name: Targeting Scopes
upgrades.effect_description: Gain Precise 1 (when you spend an aim token, reroll up to 1 additional die). Stacks with other sources of Precise X.
upgrades.notes: Sourced 2026-08-23 via web search, one clean/uncontested points figure found.

upgrades.name: Concussion Grenades
upgrades.effect_description: Adds a weapon: Range 1, 1 Black die, Blast (this attack ignores cover).
upgrades.notes: Sourced 2026-08-23 via web search, one clean/uncontested points figure found.

upgrades.name: Fragmentation Grenades
upgrades.notes: PARTIALLY SOURCED 2026-08-23: web search confirmed this adds a Range 1 weapon with a surge-to-critical effect, but didn't give a complete, confident dice count (unlike Concussion/Impact Grenades, where the full weapon profile was clear) -- left both effect_description and points as unverified rather than publish a half-confirmed weapon profile.

upgrades.name: Impact Grenades
upgrades.effect_description: Gain Impact 1 (while attacking a unit with Armor, change up to 1 hit result to a critical result).
upgrades.notes: Sourced 2026-08-23 via web search, one clean/uncontested points figure found.

upgrades.name: Duck and Cover
upgrades.notes: PARTIALLY SOURCED 2026-08-23: web search found a fragment describing 'while defending from a ranged attack, during the Apply Cover and Dodge Tokens step, you may assign yourself 1 suppression token' but not the actual benefit that assigning it grants -- an incomplete rule is worse than none, so left unverified rather than publishing a half-quoted effect.

upgrades.name: Endurance
upgrades.effect_description: Remove 1 suppression token at the end of the Activation Phase.
upgrades.notes: Effect sourced 2026-08-23 via web search. No points figure found from any checked source.

upgrades.name: Hunter
upgrades.effect_description: While attacking a wounded trooper unit, during the Roll Attack Dice step, you may gain 1 aim token.
upgrades.notes: Effect sourced 2026-08-23 via web search. No points figure found from any checked source.

upgrades.name: Overwatch
upgrades.effect_description: Grants Sentinel (your standby range is 1-3 instead of the normal range).
upgrades.notes: Sourced 2026-08-23 via web search, one clean/uncontested points figure found.

upgrades.name: Tenacity
upgrades.effect_description: While performing a melee attack, if you are wounded or one or more of your unit's minis have been defeated, add 1 red attack die to your attack pool.
upgrades.notes: Effect sourced 2026-08-23 via web search. Points cost has changed across multiple points updates since 2019 -- no current, uncontested figure found, left unverified.
